title: Insignia TV will not power on
fullDescription:
Insignia is Best Buy's house brand made by Hisense and others. Power failures most often trace to PSU capacitor failures - common after 3-5 years.

Best Buy's Geek Squad protection plan can be useful since out-of-warranty Insignia repair often costs more than replacement.
affectedModels: Insignia Fire TV, Insignia Roku TV
whenToCallPro: PSU work needs experience; check Geek Squad warranty first.
videoSearchQuery: Insignia TV won't turn on fix

faq.a: Hisense and Toshiba make most Insignia TVs for Best Buy.

title: Insignia Fire TV interface frozen
fullDescription: Most Insignia TVs run Amazon Fire TV. The interface can freeze due to memory pressure or buggy apps. Power cycle resolves most cases; clearing app cache helps for app-specific issues.

fixSteps.title: Clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Applications > Manage Apps > Clear cache.

faq.q: Is Fire TV the same as Fire Stick?
faq.a: Yes - same OS; built into Insignia and Toshiba TVs.

title: HDMI input shows no signal
fullDescription: Insignia TVs show 'No Signal' when source is off, cable loose, or wrong input. HDMI Mode setting needs to be set per port for HDR/4K60 on capable models.

faq.a: Yes on Class F30/F50 and other 4K Fire TV models.

title: Netflix won't load on Insignia
fullDescription: Netflix on Insignia Fire TV occasionally fails after app updates. Clearing data forces re-login but resolves most issues.

faq.a: Yes if you clear data or reinstall.

title: Insignia TV no audio
fullDescription: Insignia audio issues are usually output settings. Fire TV models have dedicated Audio output settings; Roku models in same Audio menu.

fixSteps.title: TV speakers
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Display & Sounds > Audio output > TV Speakers.

faq.a: Avoids Atmos passthrough mismatch when no Atmos device connected.

title: Insignia HDMI-CEC failure
fullDescription: Insignia uses Fire TV's HDMI CEC implementation. Settings are simple but get reset by firmware updates.

fixSteps.title: Enable CEC
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Display & Sounds > HDMI CEC Device Control ON.

title: Software update did not install
fullDescription:
Insignia Fire TV updates can fail with weak Wi-Fi. Wired Ethernet or moving the router closer usually fixes it.

Fire TV doesn't offer user USB updates - persistent failures need Best Buy/Amazon support.
videoSearchQuery: Insignia Fire TV update failed fix

faq.a: No - Fire TV doesn't allow user USB updates.

title: Vertical lines on display
fullDescription: Vertical lines on Insignia TVs are hardware failures - T-CON board or panel. Cheaper Insignia panels (under $300 retail) are typically not worth repairing.

fixSteps.title: Confirm internal
fixSteps.instruction: Lines on menu confirm internal fault.

fixSteps.title: Compare to replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Often cheaper to replace TV than repair on small Insignia.

title: Insignia remote not working
fullDescription: Insignia remotes are typically Alexa Voice Remote (Bluetooth) on Fire TV models or simple IR/voice on Roku models.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Home button 10 seconds near TV.

faq.q: Can I use Echo for control?

fullDescription: Backlight LED strip failure is common on Insignia LCDs after 4-6 years. Use flashlight test to confirm. Repair often costs more than replacement on smaller sets.

title: Netflix NETFLIX NW-2-5
shortDescription: Netflix app shows error NETFLIX NW-2-5 on Insignia TV, usually network-related.
fullDescription: Error NETFLIX NW-2-5 indicates a network problem between the Netflix app and its servers. Most cases clear with a sign-out, app reload, or network reset. Persistent errors may need firmware update or factory reset.

causes.cause: Stale app cache or expired session token
Outdated TV firmware or app version

fixSteps.title: Restart TV
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV for 60 seconds then power back on to clear memory.

fixSteps.title: Sign out and back in
fixSteps.instruction: Open Netflix, sign out, then sign back in to refresh the session token.

fixSteps.title: Check network
fixSteps.instruction: Run network test in TV settings; reboot router if speeds are low.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Support > Software Update; install any pending update.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall app
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the Netflix app from the home screen and reinstall from the store.

whenToCallPro: Only if errors persist after factory reset.

faq.q: Is NETFLIX NW-2-5 a TV hardware fault?
faq.a: No — it is an app/network error and clears with sign-out, reinstall, or firmware update.

title: ARC drops audio to soundbar
shortDescription: HDMI handshake/HDCP failure on Insignia TV; toggle HDMI-CEC.
fullDescription: HDMI ARC NO AUDIO indicates the TV failed to negotiate HDCP/EDID with the connected source. Common with 4K/120 Hz, eARC receivers, and long passive cables. Cycle power on both devices and try a certified Premium High Speed HDMI 2.1 cable.

causes.cause: HDCP handshake failure between source and TV
Source set to output unsupported format (4K120, Dolby Vision)
eARC/CEC conflict with AVR in chain

symptoms: Black screen with audio or no signal

fixSteps.title: Power-cycle the chain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV, source, and AVR for 2 minutes; plug TV in first, then source.

fixSteps.title: Swap HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use a certified Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 cable under 2m.

fixSteps.title: Try a different HDMI port
fixSteps.instruction: Move source to another HDMI input; label the port for 4K/120 if needed.

fixSteps.title: Match source output
fixSteps.instruction: Set the source to 4K60 RGB to test, then raise resolution/refresh.

fixSteps.title: Toggle Enhanced Format
fixSteps.instruction: TV settings > External Inputs > HDMI Signal Format > Enhanced.

whenToCallPro: Replace HDMI board if multiple ports fail with a known-good cable.
videoSearchQuery: Insignia HDMI ARC NO AUDIO fix

faq.a: For 4K120/VRR/eARC, only certified Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 cables reliably pass the handshake.
